findings.evidenceJa: 鈍く、熱を伴った目眩がする
findings.governingReading: 鈍く modifies the ensuing dizzy sensation; the passage contains no stated slow movement.
findings.explanation: Dull heated dizziness becomes Sakura moving slowly.

findings.highlight: This must be the drawback from overusing Rider.
findings.evidenceJa: こりゃ爺さんの言ってた通り、ライダーを使いすぎた反動かな
findings.governingReading: 爺さんの言ってた通り attributes the Rider-overuse account to their grandfather.
findings.explanation: Zouken’s reported explanation for Sakura’s condition is omitted.

findings.highlight: I never would've lost if Saber hadn't shown up!
findings.evidenceJa: 今だって、セイバーさえ出てこなければ僕が負ける筈がない
findings.governingReading: 今だって concerns the present situation and the upcoming encounter: Shinji says he cannot lose as long as Saber stays out of it.
findings.explanation: The English turns a claim about winning the coming rematch into a counterfactual about losing the previous fight.

findings.highlight: So he wants to kill me in front of Sakura.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の前で殺すかな、慎二
findings.governingReading: 殺すかな asks about the possibility of killing him before Sakura; Rin answers that she does not know but considers it likely.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s question whether Shinji will kill him becomes asserting Shinji wants to.
